note: GFP recreation area on the south shore of Pelican Lake, 9 mi SW of Watertown off US-212: open, mowed lakeside loops with young trees, a six-site horse camp on its own spur, two log camping cabins on the shore. Swim beach, boat ramp, fishing pier, kayak launch with rentals, archery range and 5.5 mi of trails (most open to horses). --Claude
